name: @ai-crew-suite/compose
description: Centralized multi-container orchestration blueprints, Docker Compose environment layouts, and local cluster networking profiles for spinning up isolated workbench components and Wiremock virtualization services.

scripts.check: docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo -e "\n\x1b[31m[Error] Docker is missing or not running! Please start the Docker Desktop daemon on your host machine before continuing.\x1b[0m\n" && exit 1)
scripts.lint: yarn turbo run check && echo '[Compose] Validating syntax across compose configurations...' && docker compose config
